label: AI Answer (AEO / SEO proof)
description: The proof that AEO and SEO work, made visible: a question asked of an AI assistant (typed), the answer written out word by word with citation chips ([1]), and the sources under it -- YOUR article ringed and labelled ('Your post'), with its page as a thumbnail. Optional beside it: a search for the same question, your result climbing from lower down to #1. Generic surfaces, no assistant's or search engine's brand. Use it for 'found by AI', 'cited in the answer', 'rank for what your buyers ask'. Size it wide (about 88% x 70%); without search it can be narrower.

answer.label: The answer, 2-3 sentences; put [1] after the claim your article backs (the chip)

sources.label: Up to 3 sources: {domain, title, image?}. image = the page as a thumbnail (e.g. a house blog page '/assets/_system/sample-work/fern-blog-post.webp')

highlight_label.label: The label on your source (default 'Your post')

search.label: Optional search card beside the answer: {query?, results: [{domain, title, snippet}] (3-5), ours (index of yours in results, default 0), from (the rank it starts at, 0-based, default last), at?, climb_at?}

type_speed.label: Seconds per character of the question (default 0.03)

word_speed.label: Seconds per word of the answer (default 0.045)
